subject: XRP spot/top-of-book, perpetual positioning, partial issuer-file ETF observations and XRPL amendment state

capture.note: Run start is context only. Web retrieval did not expose per-request timestamps or original HTTP headers. Publisher update times, issuer-file publication windows, ledger state IDs and event times are kept separate.

limitations: Exact provider event timestamp, retrieval timestamp and HTTP Date header were not exposed.
SHA-256 covers the rendered JSON line, not byte-complete HTTP wire bytes.
Last trade 1.21762 is above displayed best ask 1.21721; without per-field timestamps or sequence IDs these fields are not treated as synchronized or executable.
Bid/ask size ratio is a single top-level snapshot, not full depth; resting size can be cancelled.
A single-venue ticker is not consolidated spot liquidity.
USD-notional OI can decline partly because mark prices fall, not only because contracts close.
Liquidations are a lower bound because exchanges expose only part of real-time liquidation data.
Long/short ratio is account-count based, not notional exposure.
Headline OI is rounded; sum of rounded venue rows is 1.9236B USD.

order_book_positioning.methodology_status: Provider-defined positioning/wall estimate; underlying venue set, order-book snapshot sequence and cancellation treatment not exposed in the rendered page.

methodology: Holdings are read from each issuer's published holdings file; flows are calculated as day-over-day holdings changes.
Daily totals are withheld until all four daily-tracked funds have published.
The 1940 Act REX-Osprey product is excluded because direct holdings do not represent look-through XRP exposure.
Grayscale is not collected daily because its issuer page blocks automated reads; it is represented separately by quarterly SEC holdings.
The five-day complete flow window is not the same as partial Nov 4 or Nov 5 rows.
limitations: These are holdings-derived changes, not direct AP cash creation/redemption records.
Nov 4 and Nov 5 are partial and must not be treated as complete zero-flow days.
Fund holdings dates and issuer-file publication timestamps differ.

xrp_insights.fund_scope: Six US spot XRP ETFs plus the Bitwise 10 Crypto Index Fund (BITW) XRP sleeve.
methodology: Flows are derived from issuer-reported holdings changes, not issuer-reported AP cash creations/redemptions.
Flow-excluded funds contribute zero to aggregate computed flows.
BITW XRP-sleeve holdings can change from index rebalancing.
Some 2026-03-23 through 2026-04-29 and 2026-05-12 daily holdings were reconstructed from third-party flow estimates between issuer-reported anchor days.
Latest trading-day row is provisional and may be rewritten during next-morning re-settlement.
limitations: Fund universe differs from CryptoKeyhole's four daily-tracked funds.
Nov 2-Nov 4 three-day settled aggregate is not directly comparable with CryptoKeyhole's Nov 4 partial day.
A holdings change is not necessarily an AP cash flow or open-market purchase.

reconciliation.reason: Providers use different fund universes, date windows, publication vintages, exclusions and reconstruction policies. Preserve each result and completeness state separately.

effects_summary: Amendment-gated package includes fixes across permission delegation, vault/lending calculations, AMMs, permissioned DEX, trust lines, NFTs, MPTs, escrow, sponsorship and signing.
Delegated PaymentBurn issue could, under certain conditions, allow an account authorized to burn issued tokens to create them; public reporting found no publicly confirmed exploitation.
Issue concerns issued assets such as trust-line tokens and MPTs; XRP native supply was not affected.

xrpl_governance.interpretation: fixCleanup3_4_0 activation is a completed protocol-safety event. It does not itself activate the Lending Protocol or Single Asset Vault, and it is not evidence of incremental XRP demand or price impact.

claims_supported: Kraken XRP/USD ticker fields in this observation.
Seven-exchange perpetual OI and funding; five-exchange liquidation and account-ratio summaries.
Provider-displayed XRP positioning walls and flip level; not raw exchange depth.
Four-fund holdings-derived daily XRP ETF flow rows and publication completeness.
Six-spot-fund plus BITW holdings-derived flow dataset, including provisional/reconstructed/excluded status.
fixCleanup3_4_0 enabled status, activation ledger and timestamp.
Official rippled 3.4.0 release and amendment package summary.
Secondary reporting on fixCleanup3_4_0 activation, delegated-burn issue and XRP-native-supply distinction.

event_timeline.event: LendingProtocol and SingleAssetVault remain below activation threshold

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: A leveraged-long unwind is contributing to the 24-hour XRP decline.
supporting_evidence: TradRadar reports -6.76% 24-hour mark-price change and -5.51% USD-notional OI change.
Reported long liquidations are 14.45M USD versus 0.462M USD short liquidations.
Long accounts are 80.2% of the five-exchange account sample.
disconfirming_evidence: USD-notional OI can decline partly because prices fall.
Funding remains positive, so the market is not uniformly short-funded.
Liquidations are lower bounds and account counts are not notional positioning.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: The Kraken snapshot reflects an intraday rebound while price remains below the rolling 24-hour VWAP.
supporting_evidence: Kraken last trade is 0.99% above its UTC-day open.
Kraken last trade is 3.04% below its rolling 24-hour VWAP.
Displayed UTC-day high is 1.22190, above the last trade.
disconfirming_evidence: Kraken last trade is above displayed best ask, indicating unsynchronized fields or missing sequence context.
One venue cannot establish a consolidated rebound.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Apparent spot, derivatives and ETF disagreement is materially driven by source timing and coverage differences.
supporting_evidence: Kraken has no provider event timestamp; TradRadar is delayed 15 minutes; Swiftedge is an older positioning snapshot.
ETF providers have different fund universes and partial publication states.
disconfirming_evidence: Coverage differences do not rule out genuine positioning changes; synchronized native data is needed.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: ETF holdings changes may be contributing marginal XRP supply, but current daily data are incomplete.
supporting_evidence: XRP Insights reports -259,701 XRP over Nov 2-Nov 4 for six spot funds plus BITW.
CryptoKeyhole reports -3,339 XRP on Nov 4 for only three of four daily-tracked funds.
disconfirming_evidence: CryptoKeyhole reports +6,178,705 XRP across its last five complete days through Nov 3.
Nov 4 and Nov 5 are partial in CryptoKeyhole; XRP Insights' Nov 5 row is provisional.
Neither source records direct AP cash flows; the windows and universes are not comparable.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Displayed near-price depth may be thin or asymmetric, but current wall figures are not reliable executable-liquidity measurements.
supporting_evidence: Kraken displays 7,352 XRP at the best bid versus 301 XRP at the best ask.
Swiftedge displays a 3.68M XRP bid wall and a 3.08M XRP ask wall.
disconfirming_evidence: Kraken provides only a top-level ticker snapshot and its trade/quote fields are unsynchronized.
Swiftedge does not expose raw venue depth, snapshot sequence or cancellation treatment.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: XRPL protocol-safety progress is being conflated with imminent lending/collateral utility.
supporting_evidence: LendingProtocol, SingleAssetVault and LendingProtocolV1_1 remain below 29/35 votes in retrieved state snapshots.
disconfirming_evidence: Validator support can change; these are time-bounded ledger snapshots, not permanent governance outcomes.

model_ineligibility_reasons: No synchronized source cutoff across spot, derivatives, order-book and ETF data.
Kraken provider event timestamp, exact retrieval timestamp and HTTP headers were not exposed; only rendered-response text was hashed.
Kraken last-trade field is inconsistent with displayed best ask and lacks per-field sequence IDs.
Swiftedge positioning walls are not raw venue depth with disclosed methodology.
TradRadar derivatives are delayed aggregates; liquidation and long/short coverage are incomplete.
ETF daily rows are partial and derived from holdings changes; providers have different fund universes and reconstruction/exclusion policies.
XRPL amendment state and institutional/protocol events are context, not direct XRP demand or price features.
No new historical point-in-time feature batch or leakage-safe out-of-sample evaluation was executed for this observation.
next_tests: Capture exchange-native Kraken, Coinbase and Binance ticker plus depth endpoints with raw HTTP bytes, response headers, provider timestamps and monotonic request receipts.
Persist synchronized depth snapshots with venue, pair, sequence/update ID and cancellation-aware replenishment metrics.
Ingest exchange-native derivatives OI/funding/liquidation series by contract and venue; preserve USD and XRP notionals separately.
Collect each ETF issuer file directly and retain file hashes, issuer as-of dates, publication timestamps and daily completeness states.
Verify XRPL amendment status against validated-ledger RPC and retain ledger index/hash; do not infer lending activation from fixCleanup3_4_0.
Only after point-in-time history is populated, run chronological walk-forward evaluation against naive, momentum, mean-reversion and volatility baselines.
